mapper.sql: c.shop_code, c.sitecode, c.goodscode, c.combocode, c.opt1, c.opt2, c.price, c.image, c.model3d, c.model3d_marks, c.model3d_states, c.sortnum, c.status

from u_s_sitegoods_combo c left join u_s_sitegoods_combo_lang l on l.shop_code = c.shop_code and l.sitecode = c.sitecode and l.goodscode = c.goodscode and l.combocode = c.combocode and l.lang = #{lang} left join u_s_sitegoods_combo_lang d on d.shop_code = c.shop_code and d.sitecode = c.sitecode and d.goodscode = c.goodscode and d.combocode = c.combocode and d.lang = #{defaultLang}
mapper.select:
select , coalesce(l.title, d.title) as title
where c.goodscode = #{goodsCode} and c.status = '可选' order by c.sortnum, c.combocode

select , c.createuser, c.createtime, c.updateuser, c.updatetime, l.title as title from u_s_sitegoods_combo c left join u_s_sitegoods_combo_lang l on l.shop_code = c.shop_code and l.sitecode = c.sitecode and l.goodscode = c.goodscode and l.combocode = c.combocode and l.lang = #{lang} where c.goodscode = #{goodsCode} order by c.sortnum, c.combocode
select shop_code, sitecode, goodscode, combocode, lang, title from u_s_sitegoods_combo_lang where goodscode = #{goodsCode} order by combocode, lang
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_sitegoods_combo( shop_code, sitecode, goodscode, combocode, opt1, opt2, price, image, model3d, model3d_marks, model3d_states, sortnum, status, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{siteCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{comboCode}, #{opt1}, #{opt2}, coalesce(#{price}, 0), #{image}, #{model3d}, #{model3dMarks}, #{model3dStates}, coalesce(#{sortNum}, 0), coalesce(#{status}, '可选'), #{createUser}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update opt1 = values(opt1), opt2 = values(opt2), price = values(price), image = values(image), model3d = values(model3d), model3d_marks = values(model3d_marks), model3d_states = values(model3d_states), sortnum = values(sortnum), status = values(status), updateuser = values(createuser)
mapper.delete: delete from u_s_sitegoods_combo where goodscode in #{code}
delete from u_s_sitegoods_combo_lang where goodscode in #{code}
mapper.update: update u_s_sitegoods_combo set price = round(price * #{rate}, 4), updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where sitecode = (select sitecode from u_s_siteinfo limit 1) and price > 0
